name: Akane
source:
Early in the morning a night-shift janitor finds a naked student corpse in a classroom. The corpse clearly showed signs of violation. At the same time in director's office a gasping voice of a beautiful female teacher is heard. Many teachers also abuse students. An obscene world lurks behind ordinary school life. But among devilish sex cases, pure love also blooms somewhere.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
